title: 美参议员保罗谈芯片出口与AI监管
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We're joined now by the chairman of the Senate Homeland Security Committee.
segments.zh: 现在加入我们的是参议院国土安全委员会主席。

segments.en: That would be Senator Rand Paul, the Republican from Kentucky with us live on Bloomberg TV and radio.
segments.zh: 也就是肯塔基州共和党参议员兰德·保罗，正在彭博电视和广播直播。

segments.en: It's always great to see you up here on Capitol Hill. Senator, thank you for joining us. The Nvidia earnings call is underway and we've been learning some interesting headlines here, namely the fact that they're hiking their forecast for 2028.
segments.zh: 很高兴在国会山见到您。参议员，感谢加入。英伟达财报电话会正在进行，我们了解到一些有趣的标题，即他们上调了2028年的预测。

segments.en: This company is doing pretty well considering all of the headlines that we've seen most recently.
segments.zh: 考虑到最近的所有头条新闻，这家公司表现相当不错。

segments.en: With that said, the president arriving tomorrow in China, do you believe that this is an administration that is concerned about the impacts of export controls and what these
segments.zh: 话虽如此，总统明天抵达中国，您认为这届政府是否担心出口管制的影响，以及这些

segments.en: chips could do in the wrong hands? You know, I think everyone is knowing exactly what needs to be restricted and what doesn't need to be restricted is an important question.
segments.zh: 芯片落入坏人之手可能造成的后果？我认为每个人都知道什么需要限制、什么不需要限制，这是一个重要问题。

segments.en: I'm not sure I know the answer to specifically which chips need to be restricted and which don't.
segments.zh: 我不确定我具体知道哪些芯片需要限制、哪些不需要。

segments.en: But I think those decisions end up being monumental as far as people making money or losing money.
segments.zh: 但我认为这些决定对人们赚钱还是亏钱至关重要。

segments.en: Well, with that said, they're making a lot of money. And there's a big question about what has already taken place.
segments.zh: 话虽如此，他们赚了很多钱。关于已经发生的情况，存在一个大问题。

segments.en: I understand Jensen Wong has agreed to testify on Capitol Hill as has the Commerce Secretary.
segments.zh: 据我所知，黄仁勋已同意在国会山作证，商务部长也是如此。

segments.en: I'd love your thoughts on both of these and whether the Homeland Security Committee in fact will call Jensen Wong.
segments.zh: 我很想听听您对这两件事的看法，以及国土安全委员会是否真的会传唤黄仁勋。

segments.en: Don't you want to know what took place? You know, I'm not sure he can tell us what took place.
segments.zh: 您不想知道发生了什么吗？我不确定他能告诉我们发生了什么。

segments.en: I mean, he had some affairs that usually not something that precludes you from being a CEO in this country.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，他有一些事务，通常这并不妨碍一个人在这个国家担任CEO。

segments.en: It might be a lot of CEOs out of work if we made that prerequisite.
segments.zh: 如果我们把这个作为前提条件，可能会有很多CEO失业。
